claims.object_text: communicative intent through intentionally directed gaze
claims.quote: We have herein demonstrated that, through an eye tracking system, six GNAO1 patients evaluated showed variable degrees of communicative intent through intentionally directed gaze.
Moreover, three of these were able to complete a cognitive evaluation, and showed normal fluid intelligence and lexical comprehension.
